skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of taxation in government budget formation, macroeconomic regulation, and income redistribution.
Analyze the impact and effectiveness of tax policies on economic activities and income distribution.
Evaluate the efficiency and equity of tax systems and specific tax types.
Apply economic theories and models to analyze and assess the impact of tax policies.
Conduct independent research and group work on tax policies and reforms.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate real-world tax policies and reforms.
Present and defend research findings on tax policies and reforms.
Work collaboratively in groups to analyze and present on tax policies and reforms.
Enhance self-learning and research skills to accumulate knowledge on tax policies.
